Hey, I'm Gathin

Senior DevRel Lead at 0G, where I help developers build onchain AI. On the side I build things with coding agents, and one of them took off.

CleanYourTV

On 17 October 2026 I gave Claude Code my parents' TV model number because it was showing a sponsored ad before you could even get to Netflix. It found the TV on Wi-Fi, removed 25 Xiaomi packages and wrote a new launcher. I posted it on X, and it turned into CleanYourTV: debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home. No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore.

Since launch:

  • 46,000+ stars, 5,800+ forks, 430+ contributors and 1,700+ merged PRs, all since the repo went up on 17 October 2026.
  • 351 articles from 46 countries, including TechCrunch, Mashable, TechRadar, Tom's Guide, Android Authority and XDA. Full press list.
  • 387 TV models from 103 brands tested by the community, and a 572 KB launcher in 31 languages.
  • Live on Product Hunt and at cleanyour.tv.
